scope: bounded headless paced API control; no display/audio/E2E/maximum-FPS claim

environment.library: same unchanged source on both arms

paced_pipeline: filesrc high.mp4 ! qtdemux ! h264parse ! identity sync=true ! crystalhddec ! appsink emit-signals=true sync=false
counter_scope: same temporary LD_PRELOAD wrapper + explicit same DIL preload on both arms. Atomic DtsGetDriverStatus/DtsGetRecoveryStatus counters split by cached native thread-name role. CPU includes common instrumentation, setup and teardown. Status calls are not wakeup or presentation counts.
